## list

List Inboxes. `GET /inboxes`

List custom inboxes the caller can access.

Admins / owners see every inbox in the tenant. Other users see inboxes whose access_mode='all' plus any inbox where they're listed in the ACL.

```php
$result = $sendseven->customInboxes()->list();
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

Returns `InboxList`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Custom%20Inboxes/list_inboxes_api_v1_inboxes_get)

## getInbox

Get Inbox. `GET /inboxes/{inbox_id}`

Get a single inbox. 404 if it doesn't exist or the caller can't see it.

Inboxes are saved conversation views, so reads are gated by conversations:read.

```php
$result = $sendseven->customInboxes()->getInbox(inboxId: 'inbox_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$inboxId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `InboxOut`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Custom%20Inboxes/get_inbox_api_v1_inboxes__inbox_id__get)

## getInboxSenderOptions

Get Inbox Sender Options. `GET /inboxes/{inbox_id}/sender-options`

List email senders the caller may use for composing a NEW email from inside this inbox.

If the inbox has exactly one receiving email connection and that connection has a configured outbound_provider_id, that's the pre-selected default. Otherwise the caller picks from their accessible support-capable mailboxes.

```php
$sendseven->customInboxes()->getInboxSenderOptions(inboxId: 'inbox_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$inboxId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Custom%20Inboxes/get_inbox_sender_options_api_v1_inboxes__inbox_id__sender_options_get)
